parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS conflict_count FROM appointments a WHERE a.contact_id = $3::uuid AND a.business_id = $4::uuid AND a.status IN ('scheduled', 'confirmed') AND a.starts_at < ($1::timestamptz + ($2 || ' minutes')::interval) AND a.ends_at > $1::timestamptz;

INSERT INTO appointments (business_id, contact_id, conversation_id, appointment_type, title, location, starts_at, ends_at) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4, $5, $6, $7::timestamptz, $8::timestamptz) RETURNING id, contact_id, appointment_type, status, title, location, starts_at, ends_at, created_at;
